title: LOCC Dense-Codeability of the Four-Qubit W State
statement: Is the so-called four-qubit $W$ state in the LOCC dense-codeable class?
background:
Collected from Oberwolfach Reports, which document mathematical workshops and their open-problem discussions.

**Source report:** [Entanglement and Decoherence: Mathematics and Physics of Quantum Information and Computation (2005), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2005/04, pp. 185--255](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2005/04)

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-21)

**Status:** open

**Assessment.** The cited dense-coding literature develops capacity bounds and examples but does not settle whether the standard four-qubit W state is LOCC dense codeable under the report's two-receiver protocol. Later W-state communication results address related protocols, not this exact question.

**Sources checked.**

- [Bruss et al., Dense coding with multipartite quantum states](https://arxiv.org/abs/quant-ph/0507146)
- [Yeo--Chua, teleportation and dense coding with genuine multipartite entanglement](https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevLett.96.060502)
- [original OWR report](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2005/04)

This is a dated literature triage derived from the supplied OWR curation; verify time-sensitive status and cited claims independently.
